samples: This program manages a small product inventory stored in SQLite, allowing you to record stock deliveries and identify items that have fallen below their reorder thresholds. It provides functions to open the database, add received stock to items, and list all products that need reordering, sorted by current quantity. The main function demonstrates a typical workflow: opening the inventory database, recording a delivery of 500 bolts, and printing all items currently below their reorder levels.
